history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration enhance the control mechanism for contract management in order to avoid the expiration of contracts and, consequently, of performance securities, that need to be extended.
history.administration_response: The Procurement Unit of the United Nations Office at Vienna and the United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime worked with the Information Technology Service in developing a monitoring tool for contract management that provides an overview and timely reminders of the expiration dates for contracts, amendments and performance securities. The contract monitoring tool was launched in May 2021. Increased monitoring and control will continue to be exercised within the Procurement Unit and regular meetings with buyers will be held to review which contracts are terminating in the coming six months and require extensions and to confirm that the performance securities are valid.
history.board_assessment: The Board considers this recommendation implemented.
